title: Which README invariants fail?

evidence.I2: get_invoice authenticates but fetches solely by invoice ID; it never compares the row tenant to the caller tenant.
evidence.I3: The processed marker is written only after payment persistence and OrderPaid outbox insertion. A failure or concurrent delivery before that final write can produce another OrderPaid event on retry.
evidence.I4: mark_paid changes an order status but does not invalidate its cache entry.

title: Incident: lost outbox events

answer.root_cause: process_once acknowledges each row before publishing it; a crash after ack leaves the row excluded from future claim_batch calls, so its event is lost.
